limitations.note: The rewrite kept the square counter’s terminal count at 20 rather than 19, leaving a 21-clock period instead of correcting it to 20 clocks.

The rewrite forces the square output low on mode entry instead of holding the previous sample until a counter threshold, and it makes the triangle rise immediately after reset instead of preserving the original startup sequence.
The passing test encoded the incorrect 21-clock square period and the rewritten startup and mode-switch behavior, so it validated the agent’s assumptions rather than detecting the timing mismatch.
